name: Prometheus Blackbox Exporter (Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted endpoint probe exporter for HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP, ICMP and gRPC; no software-imposed monthly probe, target or seat limit.
watch_out: Requires your own Prometheus-compatible monitoring stack, compute and network; network egress may cost money. Protect the /probe endpoint from untrusted target requests; ICMP probes may require extra operating-system privileges.
